mapper.sql: create_time, update_time, bool_delete_enum, version, id, task_id, process_id, scheduling_id, product_id, product_type,inspection_quantity, team_id, user_id
mapper.select: SELECT a.`month`, IFNULL( sum( a.inspection_quantity ), 0 ) quantity, IFNULL( sum( a.qhse_quantity ), 0 ) problem_quantity FROM ( SELECT a.`month`, a.product_id, max( a.inspection_quantity ) inspection_quantity, max( a.qhse_quantity ) qhse_quantity FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT( report.create_time, "%m" ) `month`, report.process_id, report.product_id, IFNULL( sum( report.inspection_quantity ), 0 ) inspection_quantity, IFNULL( sum( qhse.qhse_quantity ), 0 ) qhse_quantity FROM mes_building_produce_inspection_team_report report LEFT JOIN mes_building_produce_qhse_team_report qhse ON report.id = qhse.inspection_team_report_id AND qhse.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE report.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND DATE_FORMAT( report.create_time, "%Y" )= DATE_FORMAT( #{dateTime}, "%Y" ) AND report.product_type = ${@com.hzchum.scim.mes.building.core.api.enums.task.TaskTypeEnum@ARTIFACT.getType()} GROUP BY month, report.product_id, report.process_id ) a GROUP BY a.`month`, a.product_id ) a GROUP BY a.`month`

SELECT report.team_id, report.inspection_quantity quantity, report.create_time, report.bool_adopt_enum, report.user_id, u.`name` user_name FROM mes_building_produce_inspection_team_report report LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON report.user_id = u.id WHERE report.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND report.process_id = #{processId} AND report.product_id = #{productId} AND report.task_type_enum =#{type} ORDER BY report.create_time DESC , report.team_id ASC

SELECT cp.serial_number 'project.serialNumber', cp.short_name 'project.shortName', pm.`name` monomerName, area.`name` areaName, pro.task_type_enum,
art.serial_number,
itr.task_process_id 'taskProcessId', itr.number 'number', itr.inspection_quantity, tulink.user_name, shop.`name` 'workshopName', itr.report_time 'passageTime', itr.update_time, su.name inspectUserName FROM mes_building_produce_inspection_team_report itr LEFT JOIN mes_building_task_process pro ON itr.task_process_id = pro.id LEFT JOIN contract_project cp ON pro.project_id = cp.id AND cp.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN plan_monomer pm ON pro.monomer_id = pm.id AND pm.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN plan_area area ON pro.area_id = area.id AND area.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN tech_artifact art ON pro.product_id = art.id AND art.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND pro.task_type_enum = 2
LEFT JOIN mes_building_workshop shop ON pro.workshop_id = shop.id AND shop.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_building_process pss ON itr.process_id = pss.id AND pss.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_building_team_user_link tulink ON itr.team_id = tulink.team_id and tulink.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON itr.user_id = su.id and su.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE itr.bool_delete_enum = 0
and
( itr.task_process_id = #{key} and number in
#{val}
)

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(tr.create_time,'%Y-%m') date, count(*) InspectQuantity FROM mes_building_produce_inspection_team_report tr where tr.bool_delete_enum = 0 GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(tr.create_time,'%Y-%m');

select count(*) from mes_building_produce_inspection_team_report tr left join mes_building_task task on tr.task_id = task.id and task.bool_delete_enum = 0 where tr.bool_delete_enum = 0 and tr.create_time > date_format(CURDATE(),'%Y-%m-%d')
and task.workshop_id = #{workShopId}
